in_marathi.name: Anilbhai
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the sky, wind
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anilbhai हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anilbhai is derived from the name Anil, which means 'Lord of the sky, wind' in Hindu mythology. This name is associated with the god Anil, who is the god of the sky and the wind in Hindu mythology. Anil is also considered to be a bringer of good fortune and is often invoked for protection and prosperity.
